_comment: Every number that is NOT measured by the eval lives here, with its source. Change and re-run `python -m business_case.model`.
_baseline_handle_minutes: Assumption: average agent handling time for an email/chat ticket in this category mix (read, classify, look up KB, write, send). Typical published range for written support is 5-10 min; 6 is conservative for repetitive deposit/withdrawal questions. Replace with the helpdesk's real AHT.

minutes_with_draft._source: Assumption: time to read ticket + review draft + check cited source + send. major_edit ~ a bit faster than writing from scratch; unusable costs slightly MORE than baseline (read the bad draft, discard it). Validate in the pilot by timing agents (A/B).

_triage_minutes_saved_when_no_draft: Assumption: classification, language, urgency and routing still save manual triage/re-assignment on tickets without a usable draft (incl. escalations).
_agent_cost_per_hour_usd: Assumption: fully-loaded cost of a support agent (salary, taxes, tools, management overhead). low = offshore BPO, base = in-house in a lower-cost hub, high = EU in-house. Replace with Finance's number.

fixed_monthly_costs_usd._source: Assumption: small container + logs/monitoring; ~0.15 FTE engineer for prompt/KB/eval upkeep and incidents (~$13k/month loaded x 0.15); ~10 h/month of a support lead curating KB/SOPs and labelling eval tickets ($60/h).

_one_off_build_cost_usd: Assumption: ~3 engineer-weeks to productionise (helpdesk app, SSO, logging, PII redaction, eval on real tickets) + support-lead time for labelling.
_judge_eval_runs_per_month: Regression eval (co-pilot + judge) on every prompt/KB/model change; measured cost per run is taken from results/summary.json.
_ticket_mix: Assumption: share of real inbox per eval slice. The eval set deliberately over-samples risky tickets (~40% of it), so results are re-weighted to a realistic mix: mostly repetitive covered questions, ~1 in 6 asking something the 4 pages don't cover, ~1 in 6 needing a specialist. Replace with the real distribution from a month of helpdesk tags.
_minutes_partial_draft: Assumption: KB answers part of the ticket; the agent still researches and writes the rest. A holding reply ('we'll check with the team') does not remove that work, so even a well-written partial draft only saves ~2 min.
_ack_minutes_saved_on_escalation: Assumption: on specialist tickets the co-pilot saves triage/re-routing plus writing the acknowledgement (~1 min); the investigation itself is unchanged.
